# Cost optimization

Optimize your Tiger Data costs without sacrificing performance. Use the links below to reduce storage and compute costs.

## I want to reduce…

- Reduce storage costs with compression
- Use [tiered storage](/build/data-management/tiered-storage) for cold data
- Configure appropriate retention policies

## Compute costs

- Right-size your instance
- Monitor resource usage

## Tiger Cloud

- [Pricing and account management](/deploy/tiger-cloud/understand/pricing-and-account-management)

## See also

- [Columnar Storage](/build/columnar-storage) — Compression and Hypercore
- [Tiered Storage](/build/data-management/tiered-storage) — Move cold data to cheaper tiers
